name: aviationstack-flight-tracker
examples_zh: 帮我查一下 AA100 今天的航班状态、登机口和预计延误时间。
追踪 UA2402 的实时位置，并告诉我它现在飞到哪里了。
查询 DL89 的出发/到达机场、航站楼、登机口和最新延误信息。
examples_en: Track AA100 today and show its status, gate, terminal, and delay details.
Where is UA2402 right now? Show its live position and latest flight status.
Look up DL89 with departure and arrival airports, terminals, gates, and current delay information.
description_zh: 实时航班追踪：登机口、延误、飞行位置，类 Flighty 体验（需 API Key）
description_en: Real-time flight tracking with gate info, delays and live position via Aviationstack
